one_liner: developer observability platform for error tracking, performance, profiling, and related telemetry
access_notes: Developers can self-serve credentials (OAuth apps, internal integrations, and personal tokens) in Sentry, but publishing a public integration for cross-org installation requires Sentry’s app review.
mcp_notes: Official MCP server provided by Sentry at mcp.sentry.dev.
blocker_notes: Public (multi-tenant) OAuth integrations must pass Sentry’s review to be published/installed by other orgs (review typically 4–5 weeks).
